correct_completion: to finish the report by Friday.
full_sentence: I hope to finish the report by Friday.
acceptable_variants: to submit the report on time.
to complete the draft by Friday.

options.why_wrong: 'Hope' is followed by a to-infinitive, not a gerund (-ing form).

options.text: to finish the report by Friday.

options.why_wrong: A bare infinitive without 'to' is ungrammatical after 'hope'.

options.text: I am finishing the report by Friday.
options.why_wrong: The stem already contains the verb 'hope', so a second finite verb cannot follow it directly.

grammar_focus: Verbs followed by infinitives: hope + to-infinitive
explanation: The verb 'hope' is followed by a to-infinitive. Learners may expect a gerund here, because many verbs of wanting and planning follow a different pattern, so the to-infinitive after 'hope' must be learned as a fixed pattern.
